title: Matter defines a shared smart-home application layer
content: Matter provides an IP-based interoperability standard intended to improve compatibility across smart-home ecosystems and device categories.

title: Edge AI reduces dependency on cloud inference
content: Improving edge accelerators and quantized models make more multimodal perception and event interpretation feasible on local hubs, reducing latency and raw-data transfer.

title: Low-power radar can sense presence without images
content: Consumer-grade radar modules increasingly support presence, distance, motion and coarse spatial sensing while avoiding conventional image capture.

title: Generative models enable adaptive explanations and interfaces
content: Structured language and multimodal models can translate complex device events into context-sensitive explanations, but action-taking requires deterministic policy boundaries.

title: Battery and bandwidth constrain always-on sensing
content: Always-on video, audio and mobile devices face power, thermal, storage and network constraints that must be treated as product-level trade-offs rather than model-only problems.
